import random, time
import feal

def g(a,b,x):
    t=(a+b+x)&0xff
    return ((t<<2)|(t>>6))&0xff

def f(inp):
    x=[0]*4
    for i in range(4):
        x[i]=inp&0xff; inp>>=8
    y=[0]*4
    y[2]=g(x[3]^x[2],x[1]^x[0],1)
    y[3]=g(x[3],y[2],0)
    y[1]=g(x[1]^x[0],y[2],0)
    y[0]=g(x[0],y[1],1)
    return (y[0]|(y[1]<<8)|(y[2]<<16)|(y[3]<<24))&0xffffffff

def attack(enc):
    # deterministic differentials:
    # beta -> gamma = 0x80800000 -> 0x02000000
    beta=0x80800000; gamma=0x02000000
    # choose delta = beta, eta = gamma
    delta=0x80800000; eta=0x02000000
    alpha=delta^gamma
    dL=alpha
    dR=beta^alpha
    dL3=beta^eta
    pairs=[]
    for _ in range(4):
        p=random.getrandbits(64)
        # ensure canonical halves
        q=((p>>32)&0xffffffff, p&0xffffffff)
        # craft q with XOR diff in L/R
        p1=p
        p2=(((q[0]^dL)<<32)|(q[1]^dR))
        c1=enc(p1); c2=enc(p2)
        cl1=(c1>>32)&0xffffffff; cr1=c1&0xffffffff
        cl2=(c2>>32)&0xffffffff; cr2=c2&0xffffffff
        r31=cl1^cr1; r32=cl2^cr2
        target=(cl1^cl2)^dL3
        pairs.append((r31,r32,target))
    found=[]
    M=1234567
    for s in range(0x10000):
        k=(s*M)&0xffffffff
        ok=True
        for a,b,t in pairs:
            if (f(a^k)^f(b^k))!=t:
                ok=False; break
        if ok:
            found.append(k)
    return found

if __name__=='__main__':
    for it in range(5):
        feal.create_random_keys()
        t=time.time(); res=attack(feal.encrypt); dt=time.time()-t
        print('key5',hex(feal.key[5]),'found',[hex(x) for x in res],'time',dt)

def _g(a, b, x):
    t = (a + b + x) & 0xFF
    return ((t << 2) | (t >> 6)) & 0xFF


def _f(value):
    x = [0] * 4
    for i in range(4):
        x[i] = value & 0xFF
        value >>= 8

    y = [0] * 4
    y[2] = _g(x[3] ^ x[2], x[1] ^ x[0], 1)
    y[3] = _g(x[3], y[2], 0)
    y[1] = _g(x[1] ^ x[0], y[2], 0)
    y[0] = _g(x[0], y[1], 1)

    return (y[0] | (y[1] << 8) | (y[2] << 16) | (y[3] << 24)) & 0xFFFFFFFF


def attack(encrypt_fn):
    import random

    beta = 0x80800000
    gamma = 0x02000000
    delta = 0x80800000
    eta = 0x02000000

    alpha = delta ^ gamma
    plain_diff_left = alpha
    plain_diff_right = beta ^ alpha
    pre_last_diff = beta ^ eta

    pairs = []
    for _ in range(4):
        p = random.getrandbits(64)
        left = (p >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        right = p & 0xFFFFFFFF
        q = (((left ^ plain_diff_left) & 0xFFFFFFFF) << 32) | (
            (right ^ plain_diff_right) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        )

        c1 = encrypt_fn(p)
        c2 = encrypt_fn(q)

        cl1 = (c1 >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        cr1 = c1 & 0xFFFFFFFF
        cl2 = (c2 >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        cr2 = c2 & 0xFFFFFFFF

        r3_1 = cl1 ^ cr1
        r3_2 = cl2 ^ cr2
        target = (cl1 ^ cl2) ^ pre_last_diff
        pairs.append((r3_1, r3_2, target))

    multiplier = 1234567
    answers = []
    for seed in range(0x10000):
        candidate = (seed * multiplier) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        for a, b, target in pairs:
            if (_f(a ^ candidate) ^ _f(b ^ candidate)) != target:
                break
        else:
            answers.append(candidate)
            if len(answers) > 1:
                break

    if not answers:
        raise ValueError("key[5] not found")
    return answers[0]
